_about: Skinned characters made by tools/build_character.py. All share one 22-bone skeleton and one animation set. 'player' is who you play. 'walk_anim_speed' is the walking speed (m/s) the Walk loop's stride matches for that body; 'label_height' is where floating text sits above them. Nora has two experimental bodies on the same rig, kept for comparison (swap one into 'model' to try it): 'model_sculpt' from image-to-sculpt (too lumpy to play) and 'model_triposr' from TripoSR (tools/run_triposr.py; good at a distance, soft face and big boots up close). She plays with the generated body until a better one exists.
